description: Use this when the user asks for ongoing DMARC monitoring, RUA report monitoring, new-sender monitoring, email-authentication alerts or ongoing DNS monitoring of a domain they own. Returns signup_url, a link to a dnsdoctor.dev page that explains monitoring and where the domain owner signs in themselves, and a short message. This call creates nothing and sends no email; the domain is filled in on their dashboard after they sign in, and monitoring starts once they prove ownership with a DNS record. Show the user the signup_url as a link together with the message.

domain.description: The domain to check, e.g. example.com. Bare registrable names and subdomains both work; scheme, path or port do not belong here. Unicode names are accepted and normalized to punycode.
domain.title: Domain
